# Squatch Snacks

> Trail snacks made in Bend, Oregon, sold by the bag and by monthly or yearly subscription.

Each snack has a page under /provisions/ with its price, weight and ingredients. The subscriptions (Day Hike, Overnight, Thru-Hike) and their monthly and yearly prices are on /pricing/. Prices are in US dollars.

# Trail snacks with a legendary following.

Small-batch snacks for long days outside. Eyewitnesses agree: once you've tried Pine Cone Crunch, you'll be spotted at the trailhead with a bag of it.

[Try Pine Cone Crunch](https://squatchsnacks.example/provisions/pine-cone-crunch/index.md) [See subscriptions](https://squatchsnacks.example/pricing/index.md)

## What eyewitnesses say

> “I saw a large figure leave a trail of Pine Cone Crunch wrappers. I followed it. Best decision of my hiking career.”

**Marta O.**, Cascade Crest, mile 2,214

> “The Huckleberry Hustle got me up the last switchback. Something else up there was eating one too.”

**Devon R.**, Mount Hood loop

> “My camera only caught a blur, but my tent smelled like s'mores the next morning.”

**Priya K.**, Olympic coast

## Common questions

**Are the snacks really eaten by Sasquatch?**

We can neither confirm nor deny. We can confirm that hikers eat them, and that the testimonials are real eyewitness accounts of the snacks.

**How does the subscription work?**

Pick a plan, pick monthly or yearly, and we mail a box on the first of each month. Skip a month or cancel any time from your account.

**Do you ship to trail towns?**

Yes. Thru-Hike members can send any box to a post office General Delivery address along the trail, and change it month to month.

**What about allergies?**

Every snack page lists its ingredients. Pine Cone Crunch, Moss Mix and Trailhead Toffee contain tree nuts; our kitchen also handles wheat and soy.

**How long do the snacks keep?**

Six months sealed, and about two weeks once the bag is open, if they last that long.

## Get trail reports

New flavors, restocks and the occasional sighting. One email a month, no more.

# About Squatch Snacks

![The pine ridge above our kitchen in Bend, at sunset](https://squatchsnacks.example/img/HBee2iM_yS-400.jpeg)

## It started with a blurry photo

In 2019, a hiker left a bag of homemade oat clusters on a stump near the Cedar trailhead. The next morning it was gone, and there was one very large footprint.

That hiker was our founder, Juniper Hale. The oat clusters became Pine Cone Crunch, and the footprint became our logo. We now make six snacks in a converted ranger station in Bend, Oregon, and mail them to hikers in all fifty states.

We cook in small batches, we buy oats and berries from farms in the Pacific Northwest, and we test every recipe on the trail before it ships.

## Why we keep doing it

> “I still leave a bag on that stump every spring. It's always gone by morning.”

**Juniper Hale**, founder

Bend, Oregon

# Fulfillment Lead

You'll lead a team of four, own the packing schedule for the first of each month, and make sure General Delivery boxes reach trail towns before the hikers do.

---
url: https://squatchsnacks.example/careers/jobs/snack-scientist/
---

# Snack Scientist

You'll run the test kitchen: new recipes, shelf-life trials, and the field tests where we hand a prototype to a hiker at mile 12 and write down what they say.

A food science degree helps; a bear canister full of trail snacks you've already perfected helps more.

---
url: https://squatchsnacks.example/careers/jobs/trail-ambassador/
---

# Trail Ambassador

From April to October you'll work trailheads across the Cascades with a cooler of samples and a notebook. Weekly check-ins by satellite messenger.

# Privacy policy

We collect as little as we can, and we never sell it.

## What we collect

- **When you visit:** a count of visits from a privacy-friendly analytics service. No cookies, and nothing that identifies you.
- **When you sign up or write to us:** the email address and message you send, kept by our form provider.
- **When you subscribe:** your shipping address and order history, kept by our payment provider.

## What we do with it

We use your email address to send the trail reports you asked for, and to answer your messages. Every email has a link to stop them.

## Questions

Write to [hello@squatchsnacks.example](mailto:hello@squatchsnacks.example).

# Bigfoot Jerky

Plant-based. Size 17.

$8.75 / 4 oz bag

Smoky mushroom and soy jerky strips, cut long enough that you'll wonder who they were sized for.

**Ingredients:** shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, smoked paprika, brown sugar.

Tart berries for the last mile.

$5.25 / 3 oz bag

Chewy huckleberry and apple fruit leather, rolled and tied with a strip of parchment so it doesn't stick to your fingers on the climb.

# Moss Mix

![A green trail mix of seeds and pistachios in a wooden bowl](https://squatchsnacks.example/img/rTrKIOI52_-400.jpeg)

[All snacks](https://squatchsnacks.example/provisions/index.md)

# Moss Mix

Green, salty and suspiciously good.

$6 / 5 oz bag

Roasted pumpkin seeds, pistachios and dried edamame tossed in seaweed and lime. It looks like the forest floor and tastes better.

**Ingredients:** pumpkin seeds, pistachios, edamame, nori, lime.

[Get it in a subscription](https://squatchsnacks.example/pricing/index.md) [Ask about wholesale](https://squatchsnacks.example/contact/?about=moss-mix)

The one the eyewitnesses can't stop talking about.

$6.50 / 5 oz bag

# Summit S'mores

Campfire not required.

$7 / 6 oz bag

Graham cracker squares sandwiching dark chocolate and a toasted marshmallow layer that stays put up to 9,000 feet.

**Ingredients:** wheat flour, dark chocolate, marshmallow, honey.

# Trailhead Toffee

A small reward for leaving the car.

$5.75 / 4 oz bag

Brittle almond toffee broken into thumb-sized shards and dusted with cocoa. Best eaten while reading the trail map.

**Ingredients:** butter, cane sugar, almonds, cocoa.

[Get it in a subscription](https://squatchsnacks.example/pricing/index.md) [Ask about wholesale](https://squatchsnacks.example/contact/?about=trailhead-toffee)

# Terms of service

By buying from Squatch Snacks or subscribing, you agree to these terms.

## Subscriptions

A subscription renews each month, or each year if you chose yearly billing, until you cancel. You can skip a month or cancel at any time before the 25th for the next box.

## Refunds

If a snack arrives damaged, write to us within 30 days and we'll send another or refund it.

## Sightings

Any resemblance between our mascot and a real cryptid is entirely alleged.
